raw_response:
I have a small 0.11 hectare plot with perennial and fruit crops here in Oromia. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for these plants because it is costly and not common for trees and perennials, but I will spread manure and compost from our animals around them to keep the soil good. I use the local varieties we already have on the farm, and I rely on the rain since there is no irrigation scheme near us. My family can manage the weeding, pruning, and harvesting ourselves this season, so I do not need to hire outside workers.
